decisions.reason: The candle arch is close to the firm's traditional wooden Christmas know-how and its repeated home-page promotion suggests enough market feedback to refine the added sound feature rather than abandon it.

This one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the firm's core craft and product knowledge very closely, so management would usually retain it unless there were clear signs of failure, which are not evident here.

Although the electronic music box stretches beyond pure woodcraft, it was prominently promoted and became the basis for related add-ons, indicating the firm has learned enough to keep developing the platform.
As a specific motif platform tied to a narrower theme, it is easier to discontinue if demand is limited, even though the second edition shows some learning and adaptation.
This Christmas-themed platform complements the music-box line and is strongly related to the firm's seasonal decorative competence, so it is more likely to be kept than removed.
A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid is highly consistent with the firm's established capabilities and regional decorative tradition, making continued marketing the more likely choice.
